data.body:
[P2] Reject templates that leave telemetry requirements uncovered

Checking only file existence allows a deployable template with missing `TestingMetadata` or a misspelled `telemetry-1` mapping. The current runner exits successfully when no descriptions match the selected suite, before evaluating `--fail-on failed+uncovered` or writing reports. Because artifact upload also ignores missing files, this workflow can pass without validating any telemetry. Add a preflight comparison of telemetry requirement IDs against template mappings and explicit `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` declarations, failing on missing required IDs, and cover the zero-match case with a regression test.
